TEXT.source: kanakanavu.info, "S. Tsuchida 2003 Story 1", https://kanakanavu.info/language-documentation/s-tsuchida-2003-story-1.html. This story was originally recorded by Shigeru Tsuchida in February 1969. The speaker is Angaiana Paepuli. The original transcription and analysis are published in Tsuchida, Shigeru (2003). Kanakanavu Texts (Austronesian Formosan). Osaka: Osaka Gakuin University (Endangered Languages of the Pacific Rim Publications Series A3-014).

S.FORM: tee-pa ku para'ʉna puiisua sua ni-paraanara naparamaci miena sua ni-pana taniarʉ.
S.PHON: teepa ku pa[r|ɾ]aʔɨna puiisua sua nipa[r|ɾ]aana[r|ɾ]a napa[r|ɾ]amaʦi miena sua nipana tania[r|ɾ]ɨ
S.FORM: teepa ku para'ʉna puiisua sua niparaanara naparamaci miena sua nipana taniarʉ.
S.PHON: teepa ku pa[r|ɾ]aʔɨna puiisua sua nipa[r|ɾ]aana[r|ɾ]a napa[r|ɾ]amaʦi miena sua nipana tania[r|ɾ]ɨ
S.TRANSL: I will be talking about the origin of Naparamaci long ago, the one who shot the sun.
現在開始說以前一個射太陽的故事。
I shall narrate about the event of Naparamaci who shot the sun long time ago.

S.FORM: tavara-o sua iisi ikamu tati'ing manasii ka'aan kamu raimi nu 'esi-pa kamu nu anʉna.
S.PHON: tava[r|ɾ]ao sua iisi ikamu tatiʔiŋ manasii kaʔaan kamu [r|ɾ]aimi nu ʔesipa kamu nu anɨna
S.FORM: tavarao sua iisi ikamu tati'ing manasii ka'aan kamu raimi nu 'esipa kamu nu anʉna.
S.PHON: tava[r|ɾ]ao sua iisi ikamu tatiʔiŋ manasii kaʔaan kamu [r|ɾ]aimi nu ʔesipa kamu nu anɨna
S.TRANSL: Know this, you little ones, so that you won't forget that if you are still there in the future.
Listen, you little ones, so that you won't forget that if you are still there in the future.
你們年輕人要聽這個故事,這樣的話你們以後絕對不會忘記。
Know this, you youngsters, so that you won't forget as long as you live in the future.

S.FORM: ateeng'-o sua makasi sua isi ia tia naka sipuu'ʉn mita sua ni-para'anara ta miena.
S.PHON: ateeŋʔo sua makasi sua isi ia tia naka sipuuʔɨn mita sua nipa[r|ɾ]aʔana[r|ɾ]a ta miena
S.FORM: ateeng'o sua makasi sua isi ia tia naka sipuu'ʉn mita sua nipara'anara ta miena.
S.PHON: ateeŋʔo sua makasi sua isi ia tia naka sipuuʔɨn mita sua nipa[r|ɾ]aʔana[r|ɾ]a ta miena
S.TRANSL: remember this, our story will convey our origin long ago.
think about this, our story will convey our origin long ago.
絕對不要忘記這個故事。
Remember like this that we are going to tell about our ancient event.

FORM.notes: source writes "ni-para'an(ara)"; its phonetic line brackets the same letters ("sanipaɾaʔan(aɾa)"), which appears to mark them as unclear

S.FORM: kanakanavu sua iisi na'ʉna.
S.PHON: kanakanavu sua iisi naʔɨna
S.FORM: kanakanavu sua iisi na'ʉna.
S.PHON: kanakanavu sua iisi naʔɨna
S.TRANSL: This is a Kanakanavu story.
這是Kanakanavu的故事。
This is a Kanakanavu story.

S.FORM: sua tia ʉna maku ia tee maku puamuamuar-ʉn sua nanakʉ ni-r<um>ariu'u miena.
S.PHON: sua tia ɨna maku ia tee maku puamuamua[r|ɾ]ɨn sua nanakɨ ni[r|ɾ]uma[r|ɾ]iuʔu miena
S.FORM: sua tia ʉna maku ia tee maku puamuamuarʉn sua nanakʉ nirumariu'u miena.
S.PHON: sua tia ɨna maku ia tee maku puamuamua[r|ɾ]ɨn sua nanakɨ ni[r|ɾ]uma[r|ɾ]iuʔu miena
S.TRANSL: As for my story, I will talk about a woman who went out for fishing by a big net.
As for my story, I will talk about a woman who went out for fishing by a scoopnet.
現在說這個故事,以前有一個女人用網子去抓魚。
As for my story, I'm going to talk about a woman who fished with ascoop-net in old days.

S.FORM: r<um>ariu'u kani sua nanakʉ.
S.PHON: [r|ɾ]uma[r|ɾ]iuʔu kani sua nanakɨ
S.FORM: rumariu'u kani sua nanakʉ.
S.PHON: [r|ɾ]uma[r|ɾ]iuʔu kani sua nanakɨ
S.TRANSL: That woman went fishing (with a net).
那個女人去抓魚。
The woman was fishing with a scoop-net.

S.FORM: para-tʉan-ʉn kan kei sua sanapisepi.
S.PHON: pa[r|ɾ]atɨanɨn kan kei sua sanapisepi
S.FORM: paratʉanʉn kan kei sua sanapisepi.
S.PHON: pa[r|ɾ]atɨanɨn kan kei sua sanapisepi
S.TRANSL: She fished out that driftwood.
拿很短的木材。
拿很短的木頭。
She scooped a driftwood.

FORM.notes: source writes "para-tʉ(a)n-ʉn"; its phonetic line brackets the same letters ("paɾate(a) nʉ"), which appears to mark them as unclear
source writes "sanap(i)sepi"; its phonetic line brackets the same letters ("sanap(i)sepi"), which appears to mark them as unclear

S.FORM: ara-'ʉn kan kei t<um>eini varuvaru canum.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]aʔɨn kan kei tumeini va[r|ɾ]uva[r|ɾ]u ʦanum
S.FORM: ara'ʉn kan kei tumeini varuvaru canum.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]aʔɨn kan kei tumeini va[r|ɾ]uva[r|ɾ]u ʦanum
S.TRANSL: She took it and threw it into the rapids (of water).
把木材丟到水裡面。
把木頭丟到水裡面。
She picked it up and threw it away in the rapids of water.

S.FORM: tee kan mara'ʉna'ʉna r<um>aru'u paratei-nʉ kan kei.
S.PHON: tee kan ma[r|ɾ]aʔɨnaʔɨna [r|ɾ]uma[r|ɾ]uʔu pa[r|ɾ]ateinɨ kan kei
S.FORM: tee kan mara'ʉna'ʉna rumaru'u parateinʉ kan kei.
S.PHON: tee kan ma[r|ɾ]aʔɨnaʔɨna [r|ɾ]uma[r|ɾ]uʔu pa[r|ɾ]ateinɨ kan kei
S.TRANSL: while still fishing, she fished it (the wood) out again.
他在抓魚,但是抓到木材。
他在抓魚,但是抓到木頭。
She fished again with a scoop-net, but she scooped the wood.

S.FORM: masang-in kan cu 'inia.
S.PHON: masaŋin kan ʦu ʔinia
S.FORM: masangin kan cu 'inia.
S.PHON: masaŋin kan ʦu ʔinia
S.TRANSL: She got tired.
他很累。
She got tired.

S.FORM: 'acu kan ara-'ʉn kei masuvuku sua sanapisepi.
S.PHON: ʔaʦu kan a[r|ɾ]aʔɨn kei masuvuku sua sanapisepi
S.FORM: 'acu kan ara'ʉn kei masuvuku sua sanapisepi.
S.PHON: ʔaʦu kan a[r|ɾ]aʔɨn kei masuvuku sua sanapisepi
S.TRANSL: she took the driftwood and stuck it into her belt.
把木材插進皮帶裡。
把木頭插進皮帶裡。
She took the driftwood to stick at the belt.

FORM.notes: source writes "sanap(i)sepi"; its phonetic line brackets the same letters ("sanap(i)sepi"), which appears to mark them as unclear

S.FORM: mucaan cu makaasi tanasa.
S.PHON: muʦaan ʦu makaasi tanasa
S.FORM: mucaan cu makaasi tanasa.
S.PHON: muʦaan ʦu makaasi tanasa
S.TRANSL: She went home.
他回到家裡。
She went home.

S.FORM: arasurumu 'akia 'inia sua karu sanapisepi.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]asu[r|ɾ]umu ʔakia ʔinia sua ka[r|ɾ]u sanapisepi
S.FORM: arasurumu 'akia 'inia sua karu sanapisepi.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]asu[r|ɾ]umu ʔakia ʔinia sua ka[r|ɾ]u sanapisepi
S.TRANSL: The driftwood was not to see anymore, it was gone.
木材一下子就不見了。
木頭一下子就不見了。
Without being noticed the driftwood disappeared.

FORM.notes: source writes "sanap(i)sepi"; its phonetic line brackets the same letters ("sanap(i)sepi"), which appears to mark them as unclear

S.FORM: arasurumu 'esi ni-pivura nanakʉ.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]asu[r|ɾ]umu ʔesi nipivu[r|ɾ]a nanakɨ
S.FORM: arasurumu 'esi nipivura nanakʉ.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]asu[r|ɾ]umu ʔesi nipivu[r|ɾ]a nanakɨ
S.TRANSL: Not seen by anyone, the woman was pregnant.
那個女人一下子就大肚子了。
那個女人一下子就懷孕了。
Unawares the woman became pregnant.

S.FORM: maramiaranou tarʉsʉ'ʉta arasumuru kamanuumanu.
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]amia[r|ɾ]anou ta[r|ɾ]ɨsɨʔɨta a[r|ɾ]asumu[r|ɾ]u kamanuumanu
S.FORM: maramiaranou tarʉsʉ'ʉta arasumuru kamanuumanu.
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]amia[r|ɾ]anou ta[r|ɾ]ɨsɨʔɨta a[r|ɾ]asumu[r|ɾ]u kamanuumanu
S.TRANSL: Afterwards, not seen by anyone, she gave birth to a child.
(不到半個月)一下子就生出小孩了。
After a while she gave birth to a child secretly.

S.FORM: kamanuumanu 'inia sua isua manusaronei m-acei cu sua nacina-in.
S.PHON: kamanuumanu ʔinia sua isua manusa[r|ɾ]onei maʦei ʦu sua naʦinain
S.FORM: kamanuumanu 'inia sua isua manusaronei macei cu sua nacinain.
S.PHON: kamanuumanu ʔinia sua isua manusa[r|ɾ]onei maʦei ʦu sua naʦinain
S.TRANSL: She gave birth to a baby boy, then the mother died.
生下男孩子後,女人就馬上死掉了。

TRANSL.notes: Tsuchida (2003) original free translation (OFTE line); she = his dead mother

S.TRANSL: When she gave birth to that boy, she died.

FORM.notes: source writes "nacin(a)-in"; its phonetic line brackets the same letters ("na:tʃin(a)ʔin"), which appears to mark them as unclear

S.FORM: mecicin cu nanara cu sua isua.
S.PHON: meʦiʦin ʦu nana[r|ɾ]a ʦu sua isua
S.FORM: mecicin cu nanara cu sua isua.
S.PHON: meʦiʦin ʦu nana[r|ɾ]a ʦu sua isua
S.TRANSL: That time he was allone, he was an orphan.
只有一個人。
He became alone, an orphan.

S.FORM: 'esi 'inia tamu-in tamu-in saronei.
S.PHON: ʔesi ʔinia tamuin tamuin sa[r|ɾ]onei
S.FORM: 'esi 'inia tamuin tamuin saronei.
S.PHON: ʔesi ʔinia tamuin tamuin sa[r|ɾ]onei
S.TRANSL: There was his grandparent around, his grandfather.
男孩子要與別人商量。
He had a grandfather.

S.FORM: sua manu isua ia aranai cu 'inia makarikari cu sua cau.
S.PHON: sua manu isua ia a[r|ɾ]anai ʦu ʔinia maka[r|ɾ]ika[r|ɾ]i ʦu sua ʦau
S.FORM: sua manu isua ia aranai cu 'inia makarikari cu sua cau.
S.PHON: sua manu isua ia a[r|ɾ]anai ʦu ʔinia maka[r|ɾ]ika[r|ɾ]i ʦu sua ʦau
S.TRANSL: As for this child, since then the people talked about it.
要到男孩子家商量。
Then, people talked over.

S.FORM: pu-'una cakʉrʉ tee cu pua'isua kaavuuvuuru.
S.PHON: puʔuna ʦakɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ tee ʦu puaʔisua kaavuuvuu[r|ɾ]u
S.FORM: pu'una cakʉrʉ tee cu pua'isua kaavuuvuuru.
S.PHON: puʔuna ʦakɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ tee ʦu puaʔisua kaavuuvuu[r|ɾ]u
S.TRANSL: They were talking in the men's house, discussing the hunting (using bow and arrow).
At the men's house people talked over about the hunting ritual.

S.FORM: pu-'una cakʉrʉ tee cu pua'isua sua kaavuuvuuru.
S.PHON: puʔuna ʦakɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ tee ʦu puaʔisua sua kaavuuvuu[r|ɾ]u
S.FORM: pu'una cakʉrʉ tee cu pua'isua sua kaavuuvuuru.
S.PHON: puʔuna ʦakɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ tee ʦu puaʔisua sua kaavuuvuu[r|ɾ]u
S.TRANSL: They were talking in the men's house, discussing the hunting (using bow and arrow).
At the men's house people talked over about the hunting ritual.

S.FORM: makariikari kan sua cau pu-'una cakurʉ tia pu'isua ʉcʉpʉ mamanu.
S.PHON: maka[r|ɾ]iika[r|ɾ]i kan sua ʦau puʔuna ʦaku[r|ɾ]ɨ tia puʔisua ɨʦɨpɨ mamanu
S.FORM: makariikari kan sua cau pu'una cakurʉ tia pu'isua ʉcʉpʉ mamanu.
S.PHON: maka[r|ɾ]iika[r|ɾ]i kan sua ʦau puʔuna ʦaku[r|ɾ]ɨ tia puʔisua ɨʦɨpɨ mamanu
S.TRANSL: The people discussed at the men's house, talking about the dreams the children had.
大家到男孩子那裡商量,什麼人的運氣好。
At the men's house people talked over about the dream which youngsters had.

S.FORM: 'akia 'inia sua mustea mamanʉng ʉcʉp-in.
S.PHON: ʔakia ʔinia sua mustea mamanɨŋ ɨʦɨpin
S.FORM: 'akia 'inia sua mustea mamanʉng ʉcʉpin.
S.PHON: ʔakia ʔinia sua mustea mamanɨŋ ɨʦɨpin
S.TRANSL: There was no suitable dream for the ritual.
昨天晚上沒有人做了好夢。
There was no good dream fit for the ritual.

S.FORM: makasua kan cu sua tamu-'in naai kitanam-ei kisoin-ei manu isi misa kani.
S.PHON: makasua kan ʦu sua tamuʔin naai kitanamei kisoinei manu isi misa kani
S.FORM: makasua kan cu sua tamu'in naai kitanamei kisoinei manu isi misa kani.
S.PHON: makasua kan ʦu sua tamuʔin naai kitanamei kisoinei manu isi misa kani
S.TRANSL: If it is like that (that you guys don't have anybody else to ask), the grandfather said,"well, try to ask this child".
爺爺說如果沒有人的話先問看看那個孩子。
Then his grandfather said, "Well, try to ask this child."

S.FORM: kisoenar-ei sua cau sua manu.
S.PHON: kisoena[r|ɾ]ei sua ʦau sua manu
S.FORM: kisoenarei sua cau sua manu.
S.PHON: kisoena[r|ɾ]ei sua ʦau sua manu
S.TRANSL: The people tried to ask the child.
那個人問孩子。
People tried to ask the child.

S.FORM: puamuamuar-ei kan 'inia.
S.PHON: puamuamua[r|ɾ]ei kan ʔinia
S.FORM: puamuamuarei kan 'inia.
S.PHON: puamuamua[r|ɾ]ei kan ʔinia
S.TRANSL: He talked to them.
一直在商量。
He talked to them.

S.FORM: matavʉcʉke kani sipuumuamuarʉ-'in ʉcʉp-in pa-tiurei kan sua tamu-in sua ivici manu.
S.PHON: matavɨʦɨke kani sipuumuamua[r|ɾ]ɨʔin ɨʦɨpin patiu[r|ɾ]ei kan sua tamuin sua iviʦi manu
S.FORM: matavʉcʉke kani sipuumuamuarʉ'in ʉcʉpin patiurei kan sua tamuin sua ivici manu.
S.PHON: matavɨʦɨke kani sipuumuamua[r|ɾ]ɨʔin ɨʦɨpin patiu[r|ɾ]ei kan sua tamuin sua iviʦi manu
S.TRANSL: When he was telling them his imagination (of the ritual), his grandfather stopped (the mouth of) the child.
小孩和爺爺商量夢。
When he talked half of his dream, his grandfather covered the mouth of the child with his hand to stop him talking.

S.FORM: mucaan cu sua cau maavuvurʉ aranai cakʉrʉ makaasi tanasa.
S.PHON: muʦaan ʦu sua ʦau maavuvu[r|ɾ]ɨ a[r|ɾ]anai ʦakɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ makaasi tanasa
S.FORM: mucaan cu sua cau maavuvurʉ aranai cakʉrʉ makaasi tanasa.
S.PHON: muʦaan ʦu sua ʦau maavuvu[r|ɾ]ɨ a[r|ɾ]anai ʦakɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ makaasi tanasa
S.TRANSL: The people came from the men's house and split to go to their homes.
走了. 他們分開回各自的家。
People parted with each other from the men's house to go home.

S.FORM: kamu pucipasu.
S.PHON: kamu puʦipasu
S.FORM: kamu pucipasu.
S.PHON: kamu puʦipasu

S.FORM: tee cu mu'aca tee kaavuuvuuru.
S.PHON: tee ʦu muʔaʦa tee kaavuuvuu[r|ɾ]u
S.FORM: tee cu mu'aca tee kaavuuvuuru.
S.PHON: tee ʦu muʔaʦa tee kaavuuvuu[r|ɾ]u
S.TRANSL: They went to have the hunting ritual.
回家準備製作弓箭。
The hunting ritual was going to be held.

S.FORM: manu kan isua sua ni-mu'uru'uru.
S.PHON: manu kan isua sua nimuʔu[r|ɾ]uʔu[r|ɾ]u
S.FORM: manu kan isua sua nimu'uru'uru.
S.PHON: manu kan isua sua nimuʔu[r|ɾ]uʔu[r|ɾ]u
S.TRANSL: The child was the one who went first.
小孩先走了。
The one who went first was the child.

S.FORM: maripaapa cau mucaan cu kaavuuvuuru sua cau.
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]ipaapa ʦau muʦaan ʦu kaavuuvuu[r|ɾ]u sua ʦau
S.FORM: maripaapa cau mucaan cu kaavuuvuuru sua cau.
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]ipaapa ʦau muʦaan ʦu kaavuuvuu[r|ɾ]u sua ʦau
S.TRANSL: The people were taken along to the hunting ritual.
我帶你去. 回家準備做弓箭。
People went with each other to the hunting ritual.

S.FORM: poi'i makai teeciure-ni tee cu areisi tia apiapʉʉtʉ.
S.PHON: poiʔi makai teeʦiu[r|ɾ]eni tee ʦu a[r|ɾ]eisi tia apiapɨɨtɨ
S.FORM: poi'i makai teeciureni tee cu areisi tia apiapʉʉtʉ.
S.PHON: poiʔi makai teeʦiu[r|ɾ]eni tee ʦu a[r|ɾ]eisi tia apiapɨɨtɨ
S.TRANSL: They returned in the morning, they stayed in the mountains and did a shooting ritual.

TRANSL.notes: apia-pe:tʉ: 製作短的弓箭先射擊小鳥做測試

S.TRANSL: 一大早起來要準備apia-pe:tʉ。
About dawn they returned, and stayed in the mountains (for the first time after kaavuuvuuru) and were going to practice shooting ritual.

S.FORM: ʉtun-ei kan sua cau sua seisii paasanukuuvuuvu kan sua cau.
S.PHON: ɨtunei kan sua ʦau sua seisii paasanukuuvuuvu kan sua ʦau
S.FORM: ʉtunei kan sua cau sua seisii paasanukuuvuuvu kan sua cau.
S.PHON: ɨtunei kan sua ʦau sua seisii paasanukuuvuuvu kan sua ʦau
S.TRANSL: People found a jaw bone in an upside down position.
後來找到山豬的骨頭,將山豬翻過來。
People found a jaw-bone of a wild pig put upside down.

S.FORM: nu tee-in apiapʉʉtʉ maica kan 'inia sua manu nanara.
S.PHON: nu teein apiapɨɨtɨ maiʦa kan ʔinia sua manu nana[r|ɾ]a
S.FORM: nu teein apiapʉʉtʉ maica kan 'inia sua manu nanara.
S.PHON: nu teein apiapɨɨtɨ maiʦa kan ʔinia sua manu nana[r|ɾ]a

TRANSL.notes: the Chinese translation is merged with the previous sentence's (source FTC: "(與前一句合併)")

S.TRANSL: If someone did the shooting ritual, the orphan child must have been passed this way.

TRANSL.notes: Tsuchida (2003) original free translation (OFTE line); shooting ritual: 'apia-péete

S.TRANSL: If (there is someone who) practiced shooting ritual, it must be the orphan child who passed here.

S.FORM: aritakar-ei 'esi 'inia sua seisi pasanivouvou.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]itaka[r|ɾ]ei ʔesi ʔinia sua seisi pasanivouvou
S.FORM: aritakarei 'esi 'inia sua seisi pasanivouvou.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]itaka[r|ɾ]ei ʔesi ʔinia sua seisi pasanivouvou
S.TRANSL: They put the jaw bone in the right position.
朝上面放好。
They set up the jaw-bone in the normal position!

S.FORM: makasi nu tee kia apiapʉʉtʉ.
S.PHON: makasi nu tee kia apiapɨɨtɨ
S.FORM: makasi nu tee kia apiapʉʉtʉ.
S.PHON: makasi nu tee kia apiapɨɨtɨ
S.TRANSL: "If it is like this we (can) do the shooting ritual."
他要開始apia-pʉtʉ。
It should be like this if we practice shooting ritual."

S.FORM: ka'aan mamanʉng nuu tee-in s<um>aasanikuuvuu.
S.PHON: kaʔaan mamanɨŋ nuu teein sumaasanikuuvuu
S.FORM: ka'aan mamanʉng nuu teein sumaasanikuuvuu.
S.PHON: kaʔaan mamanɨŋ nuu teein sumaasanikuuvuu
S.TRANSL: "It is not good if it is put upside down."
不要上下顛倒放置。
It is not good if he put it upside down".

S.FORM: tia s<um>asanvouvou sua seisi manasi s<um>asanianan misei sua naparamaci.
S.PHON: tia sumasanvouvou sua seisi manasi sumasanianan misei sua napa[r|ɾ]amaʦi
S.FORM: tia sumasanvouvou sua seisi manasi sumasanianan misei sua naparamaci.
S.PHON: tia sumasanvouvou sua seisi manasi sumasanianan misei sua napa[r|ɾ]amaʦi
S.TRANSL: "The jaw bone has to be in the right position so that the jaw lies with the right side up", said Naparamaci.
Naparamaci說:山豬的頷骨一定要在右手邊。
"The jaw-bone should be put in the normal position with the rightside of the jaw up," said the ancestors.

S.FORM: aranai cu sua mʉtʉ-'ʉn cu cʉpʉng-in sua manu isua.

S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]anai ʦu sua mɨtɨʔɨn ʦu ʦɨpɨŋin sua manu isua
S.TRANSL: Since then they found out what this child had in mind.
小孩子想到了。
Hence they found what that child thought.

S.FORM: tee cu tia pana-'ʉn taniarʉ misei.

S.TRANSL: "He will shoot the sun", they said.
他們說:他(小孩)要射太陽。
"He will shoot the sun," they said.

S.FORM: sua vuur-in ia ni-kaamanʉnga vava tutui sia'urupacai-'in.

S.TRANSL: As for his bow, it was made of a pig rib, a thing for killing purpose.
用豬的肋骨做成弓箭用來射(太陽)。
For his bow, it was made of a pig-rib, which was the thing used by him.

S.FORM: 'esi kan mia-kitngavin.

S.FORM: 'esi kan miakitngavin.

S.TRANSL: It started.
要開始準備(射太陽)。
It already started.

S.FORM: tia paarane-in tia mu-pana'ʉ sua taniarʉ ia ni-mu-'una kan tanasa sua cina-'ini arasi'isiina.
S.PHON: tia paa[r|ɾ]anein tia mupanaʔɨ sua tania[r|ɾ]ɨ ia nimuʔuna kan tanasa sua ʦinaʔini a[r|ɾ]asiʔisiina
S.FORM: tia paaranein tia mupana'ʉ sua taniarʉ ia nimu'una kan tanasa sua cina'ini arasi'isiina.
S.PHON: tia paa[r|ɾ]anein tia mupanaʔɨ sua tania[r|ɾ]ɨ ia nimuʔuna kan tanasa sua ʦinaʔini a[r|ɾ]asiʔisiina
S.TRANSL: The one who was allowed to shoot the sun had his mother at home, who gathered firewood.
The one who was allowed to shoot the sun had his aunt at home, who gathered firewood.
媽媽蒐集了木材在家,要準備射太陽。
媽媽蒐集了木頭在家,要準備射太陽。
The one who was going to go to shoot the sun had his aunt at home, who went out to gather firewood.

S.FORM: 'esi kan 'una kan sua aracakaan api'ara'arang sua 'araam 'avara maamia.
S.PHON: ʔesi kan ʔuna kan sua a[r|ɾ]aʦakaan apiʔa[r|ɾ]aʔa[r|ɾ]aŋ sua ʔa[r|ɾ]aam ʔava[r|ɾ]a maamia
S.FORM: 'esi kan 'una kan sua aracakaan api'ara'arang sua 'araam 'avara maamia.

S.TRANSL: There was a hunting one who prepared whatever meat.
有個獵人準備所有的肉。
There was the one who went hunting to provide meat of any kind.

S.FORM: tia camai-'in kʉna kavangvang karu ʉm-'ʉsʉ tanasa.

S.PHON: tia ʦamaiʔin kɨna kavaŋvaŋ ka[r|ɾ]u ɨmʔɨsɨ tanasa
S.TRANSL: His fathers had food and all of the wood and stored it in the house.
他的父親準備了食物和木材在家。
His uncles collected food, all woods, and stored away in the house.

S.FORM: tee noumani musu sua isua tia eikui pana-'ʉn naparamaci musu sua taniarʉ kisoe kan cau.

S.TRANSL: "What are you doing with these things?Perhaps your Naparamaci will shoot the sun?" the people said.
人們問:你要這些東西做甚麼?難道你(Naparamaci)也要射太陽嗎？
What are you going to do with these? Perhaps your Naparamaci is going to shoot the sun?" asked people.

S.FORM: ka'aan kan marivari sua mamarang-ini.

S.TRANSL: His parent did not answer.
他的父母並沒有回答。
His parent did not answer.

S.TRANSL: "I'll gather firewood since there will be no firewood", he said only.
他只說：因為沒有木柴所以我要蒐集些。
"All the same I'll store firewood, because there will be no firewood," he just said.

S.FORM: arara'unusʉ sua isua 'esi kan cu kiatarisi.

S.TRANSL: He finished that. Then he made a rope.
當他完成後，接著製作繩索。
That ended. He was making a rope.

S.FORM: tatiana puungana sua nikitarisi kei.
S.PHON: tatiana puuŋana sua nikita[r|ɾ]isi kei
S.TRANSL: The rope he made was big as a water vessel.
繩索之大有如水盆。
The rope he made was as big as a water vessel.

S.FORM: tee noumani musu kisone kan cau.

S.FORM: tee noumani musu kisone kan cau.
S.PHON: tee noumani musu kisone kan ʦau
S.TRANSL: "What will you do with that?" asked the people.
人們問：那是什麼？
"What are you going to do?" asked people.

S.FORM: ka'aan kan maamia marivari.
S.PHON: kaʔaan kan maamia ma[r|ɾ]iva[r|ɾ]i
S.FORM: ka'aan kan maamia marivari.
S.PHON: kaʔaan kan maamia ma[r|ɾ]iva[r|ɾ]i
S.TRANSL: He just did not answer.
他就沒有回答。
He just did not answer.

S.FORM: tee kan cu mu'aca mataa vai-in.

S.FORM: tee kan cu mu'aca mataa vaiin.
S.PHON: tee kan ʦu muʔaʦa mataa vaiin
S.TRANSL: He (the child) was going to leave with his friend.
他（小孩）離開了他的朋友。
He was going to go with his friend.

S.FORM: tee cu pana-'ʉn kei sua taniarʉ.

S.FORM: tee cu pana'ʉn kei sua taniarʉ.
S.PHON: tee ʦu panaʔɨn kei sua tania[r|ɾ]ɨ
S.TRANSL: They were going to shoot the sun.
他們要去射太陽。
They were going to shoot the sun.

S.FORM: kiri-ei kan 'inia na taa-kiringa sua tarisi.

S.TRANSL: He tied the rope at a place with a small basket.
他在某處將繩索和一個小籃子綁在一起。
He tied the rope at a small basket.

S.FORM: tarakari-'ei kan 'inia tamu-'in.

S.FORM: tarakari'ei kan 'inia tamu'in.
S.PHON: ta[r|ɾ]aka[r|ɾ]iʔei kan ʔinia tamuʔin
S.TRANSL: He asked his grandfather.
他問他的爺爺。
He asked his grandfather.

S.FORM: nuu mari-kirling-kirling ku mari-'a-psanʉ ia 'esi kimi'ei matʉa.
S.PHON: nuu ma[r|ɾ]iki[r|ɾ]*iŋki[r|ɾ]*iŋ ku ma[r|ɾ]iʔapsanɨ ia ʔesi kimiʔei matɨa
S.FORM: nuu marikirlingkirling ku mari'apsanʉ ia 'esi kimi'ei matʉa.

S.TRANSL: "If I pull the rope twice and make 'ring ring' we will be alive both.
如果我拉繩子兩次並且發出＂喀鈴喀鈴＂的聲音，我們兩個就會活下來。
"If I pulled the rope twice and made noise 'kiling', we would be alive the same."

FORM.notes: source writes "mari-kir(l)ing-kir(l)ing"; its phonetic line brackets the same letters ("nu:maɾikiɾ(l)iŋkiɾ(l)iŋku"), which appears to mark them as unclear

S.FORM: nuu mari'anʉ ku maamia 'akia'ei taciin misa kani.

S.TRANSL: If I pull it only once, one of us will be not there perhaps", he said.
他說：如果我只拉一次，那麼我們之中一個人就可能不在了。
"If I pulled it only once, one of us would be perhaps not alive," he said.

S.FORM: mucaane kan cu mu-avici sua tarisi makacukʉna na tapakatara'una taniarʉ.

S.FORM: mucaane kan cu muavici sua tarisi makacukʉna na tapakatara'una taniarʉ.

S.TRANSL: They took the rope with them and arrived at the place where the sun rises.
他們帶繩子到太陽升起的地方。
They carried the rope with them, and arrived at the place where the sun rises.

S.FORM: mu-'una 'inia mu-ramang sua taniarʉ.

S.FORM: mu'una 'inia muramang sua taniarʉ.

S.TRANSL: They were ambushing the sun.
他們要伏擊太陽。
They were ambushing the sun.

S.FORM: ararakau kan tapakatara'una'ini taniarʉ.

S.TRANSL: The sun appeared at the rising place.
太陽出現在升起的地方。
They were ambushing the sun.

S.FORM: maritupuku cu sua tatupuru'ini sua takuisin cumai pana'ei kan 'inia.

S.TRANSL: He threw the bear leather (he wore) towards the place he sat and then he shot it (the sun).
他把穿在身上的熊皮衣丟向他坐的地方然後射太陽。
He dusted his sitting place with his garment made of bear leather, and shot it.

S.FORM: tavʉrʉ kan sua ni-mu-pana'ʉ.

S.FORM: tavʉrʉ kan sua nimupana'ʉ.
S.PHON: tavɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ kan sua nimupanaʔɨ
S.TRANSL: The one who shot jumped into water.
射太陽的人跳進水裡。
The one who shot jumped into the water.

S.FORM: 'acu kan s<in>akʉna nimuuru-'in sua navai-'in.

S.FORM: 'acu kan sinakʉna nimuuru'in sua navai'in.

S.TRANSL: His former friend must have been hit by its (the sun's) blood. (He died.)
他之前的朋友被太陽的血擊中。（死亡）。
His friend must have been hit by the blood of the sun. He died.

S.FORM: marikilingi kan marian maamia.

S.FORM: marikilingi kan marian maamia.
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]iki*iŋi kan ma[r|ɾ]ian maamia
S.TRANSL: He made 'ring ring' and pulled (the rope) just once.
他發出＂喀鈴喀鈴＂並只拉繩子一次。
He pull the rope just once to make noise 'kiling'.

S.FORM: aranai cu 'una-ei isua vʉrʉʉngana cu.

S.FORM: aranai cu 'unaei isua vʉrʉʉngana cu.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]anai ʦu ʔunaei isua vɨ[r|ɾ]ɨɨŋana ʦu
S.TRANSL: From that time on, it was night.
從這時候開始，就是夜晚了。
Since when it happened, it became dark.

S.FORM: kipapa-'ei cu 'inia tarisi.

S.FORM: kipapa'ei cu 'inia tarisi.
S.PHON: kipapaʔei ʦu ʔinia ta[r|ɾ]isi
S.TRANSL: He went along the rope.
他帶著繩子走了。
He went back along the rope.

S.FORM: matipapa makaasi mucaan haipa pia to vʉrʉʉngana makacukʉna tanasa.
S.PHON: matipapa makaasi muʦaan haipa pia to vɨ[r|ɾ]ɨɨŋana makaʦukɨna tanasa
S.TRANSL: He held the rope and went back, and after several days and nights, he arrived at home.
他拿著繩子回去。幾天後他抵達家中。
He followed the rope by holding it and after several days and nights arrived at home.

FORM.notes: Bunun (the source labels the whole unit); source writes "haipa pia to (BUN)"

S.FORM: 'esi cu mi'aranas sua cau.

S.FORM: 'esi cu mi'aranas sua cau.
S.PHON: ʔesi ʦu miʔa[r|ɾ]anas sua ʦau
S.TRANSL: The people were in trouble.
人們很困擾。
People were in trouble.

S.FORM: 'akia cu si'si'ina-in 'akia cu kʉna-'in.

S.FORM: 'akia cu si'si'inain 'akia cu kʉna'in.
S.PHON: ʔakia ʦu siʔsiʔinain ʔakia ʦu kɨnaʔin
S.TRANSL: There was no firewood, no food.
沒有木材也沒有食物。
There were no firewood, nor foods.

S.FORM: ka'aan tavara'ʉ 'esi ni-papi'ara'arang sua nguain kavang.

S.FORM: ka'aan tavara'ʉ 'esi nipapi'ara'arang sua nguain kavang.
S.PHON: kaʔaan tava[r|ɾ]aʔɨ ʔesi nipapiʔa[r|ɾ]aʔa[r|ɾ]aŋ sua ŋuain kavaŋ
S.TRANSL: They did not know that they (Naparamaci's family) prepared for all.
他們不知道Naparamaci的家人是不是準備了所有人的份。
People did not know that they (family of Naparamaci) had prepared for all.

S.FORM: 'akia cu maamia i'aranase-'in.
S.PHON: ʔakia ʦu maamia iʔa[r|ɾ]anaseʔin
S.FORM: 'akia cu maamia i'aranase'in.
S.PHON: ʔakia ʦu maamia iʔa[r|ɾ]anaseʔin
S.TRANSL: They had just no trouble.
他們沒有困擾了。
They had no trouble.

S.FORM: siroi'ei.
S.PHON: si[r|ɾ]oiʔei
S.FORM: siroi'ei.
S.PHON: si[r|ɾ]oiʔei
S.TRANSL: The people were in big trouble.
人們非常困擾。
People were in big trouble.

S.FORM: si'ina-'ʉn kan cu cau sua naata'ʉʉn-ini kan naa'aniv-in kavangvang maamia naanounoumani-i.

S.FORM: si'ina'ʉn kan cu cau sua naata'ʉʉnini kan naa'anivin kavangvang maamia naanounoumanii.

S.TRANSL: They made fire with their chairs, with their walls and everything.
他們把他們的椅子、牆和所有東西都給燒了。
They made fire with their chairs, walls, and everything.

S.FORM: 'esi pati'uri'uring kani 'arupa-'uri'uring.

S.FORM: 'esi pati'uri'uring kani 'arupa'uri'uring.
S.PHON: ʔesi patiʔu[r|ɾ]iʔu[r|ɾ]iŋ kani ʔa[r|ɾ]upaʔu[r|ɾ]iʔu[r|ɾ]iŋ
S.TRANSL: They were lighting up fire to each other.
他們用火互相照明。
People were carrying fire to each other.

S.FORM: ngutein mu'ana'una'uvun ngute'in ma'ara kʉna 'avara maamia ngute'in muacanumu.
S.PHON: ŋutein muʔanaʔunaʔuvun ŋuteʔin maʔa[r|ɾ]a kɨna ʔava[r|ɾ]a maamia ŋuteʔin muaʦanumu
S.TRANSL: Some of them went to the fallow, some brought whatever food, some went to the water.
有些人去了休耕地，有些人帶了任何可吃的食物，有些人去了水邊。
Some of them went to the fallow (to find crops), some brought food of what so ever, some fetched water.

S.FORM: 'esi manasasiavʉ sua ta'esi'a naparamaci ni-mu-pana'ʉ taniarʉ.

S.TRANSL: Those who were at Naparamaci's place, who shot the sun, were satisfied.
那些曾在Naparamaci處將太陽射下的人十分滿足。
Those who were at the place of Naparamaci who shot the sun were rich.
